subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt datetime-suffixed config backups now, and if so must legacy `.bak.N` backups be migrated or retained during the upgrade window?
rationale: The format change is useful, but it changes recovery artifacts for existing users and the current PR intentionally deletes old backup slots before replacement history exists.

options.title: Require migration-safe datetime backups
options.body: Keep the datetime naming direction but require the PR to preserve or convert existing `.bak.N` files until equivalent retention exists, with upgrade tests and real behavior proof.

options.title: Keep the numbered ring for now
options.body: Pause this PR and keep tracking datetime naming in the linked product issue until a maintainer chooses the migration policy.

recommendation.title: Require migration-safe datetime backups
recommendation.body: Keep the datetime naming direction but require the PR to preserve or convert existing `.bak.N` files until equivalent retention exists, with upgrade tests and real behavior proof.
